The '''Ramos family''' was a wealthy [[Human/Legends|Human]] family on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. When their child [[Arfan Ramos]] was discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], the family chose to send Ramos to the [[Corellian Jedi|Green Jedi]] instead of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
